03 — Ideal Brand Fit

Brands That Align With My Niche

D2C and consumer categories where Mothers Inside drives high organic discovery, parent trust, and purchase intent.

Category 01

Baby Skincare & Bath

Gentle baby washes, moisturizers, diaper rash creams, massage oils, and newborn-safe daily essentials.

Category 02

Maternity & Postpartum Care

Stretch mark oils, nursing wear, maternity pillows, postpartum recovery kits, and comfort essentials.

Category 03

Infant Nutrition & Feeding

Clean baby food brands, organic purees, feeding bottles, breast pumps, sterilizers, and weaning gear.

Category 04

Baby Gear & Nursery

Ergonomic baby carriers, strollers, cribs, swaddles, baby monitors, and travel-friendly essentials.

Category 05

Clean Home & Baby Laundry

Plant-based baby laundry detergents, bottle cleansers, gentle disinfectants, and nursery hygiene products.

Category 06

Mom Wellness & Lifestyle

Prenatal & postnatal nutrition, lactation-friendly snacks, skincare for moms, and parenting apps.

Standard Campaign

Base Scope (Included)

  • Ideal For: Standard organic collaborations (single or multi-platform)
  • Deliverable: 1 concept, 30–60 sec video (script, shoot & edit) with 1 revision round
  • Distribution: Organic native posting on selected platform(s)
  • Timeline & Payment: 5–7 business days turnaround; 50% advance & 50% prior to publishing

Quoted Separately

Additional Scope & Terms

  • Multi-Team Approvals: Multiple stakeholder rounds, legal/compliance checks, or extra revisions
  • Production & Rush: Multiple hook variations (A/B testing), custom setups, or 48–72 hr express delivery
  • Commercial Rights: Paid ad usage / whitelisting, raw unedited footage, or category exclusivity
  • Payment Cycles: Extended agency/enterprise invoicing terms (Net 30 / Net 60)
